title: Legacy P2SH multisig

schema.keys: 33 or 65 bytes, and only in P2SH

note: The check matches m, then that many compressed or uncompressed keys, then n, then CHECKMULTISIG. m and n are OP_1 through OP_16. It clears fake-multisig only when that script is the P2SH redeem script for the input. A witness script with the same bytes stays marked. A 65-byte key in a witness is not this row. Not an insert package.
